title: File:AHOM ROYAL PALACE GARGAON-KAREG GHAR.jpg
author: Mayurgogoi
description: Icon of Ahom KIngs' Royal palace popularly called Kareg Ghar-this present building was constructed around 1752 as the present seven-storied structure by Rajeswar Singha (Suremphaa, 1751-1769).I have taken this pics when candle light - Me Dam Me Phi,2019 .This festival was a tribute in name of forefathers.
period_note: Surviving masonry predominantly 18th century; not direct evidence for a 15th-century palace
